st: The Case of the Midnight Howler
d: A man is shot to death while his vast radio audience, including Perry Mason, listens in horror.

st: The Case of the Vanishing Victim
d: Perry Mason faces a set of mysteries: a private plane crash, a missing drug supply, and a millionaire leading a double life.

st: The Case of the Golfer's Gambit
d: A professional golfer is murdered following his biggest victory and the young opponent he defeated is charged with the crime.

st: The Case of the Sausalito Sunrise
d: Perry Mason defends an art gallery owner and his attractive Girl Friday twice accused of murder.

st: The Case of the Scarlet Scandal
d: An art patroness is slain and the young musician she befriended is charged with the crime.

st: The Case of the Twice-Told Twist
d: After his car is broken into, Perry Mason give a teenage criminal a second chance until the teen is charged with murder.

st: The Case of the Tsarina's Tiara
d: An international jewel thief is murdered and a gem authority in South America is charged with the crime.

st: The Case of the Fanciful Frail
d: Two women switch identities: one to recover the $50,000 she is suspected of stealing and the other to elude a paid assassin.

st: The Case of the Unwelcome Well
d: A ruthless oil tycoon is slain and the young geologist he betrayed is charged with the crime.

st: The Case of the Dead Ringer
d: Raymond Burr plays a double role as both lawyer Perry Mason and as a Cockney merchant seaman in a plot to discredit Mason.

st: The Case of the Misguided Model
d: A glamorous model is threatened and the showy figure who tried to wreck her career is murdered.

st: The Case of the Positive Negative
d: A retired general heading a local cleanup commission is charged with murder when the community's crime boss is found dead.

st: The Case of the Crafty Kidnapper
d: A columnist is slain and the witnesses who could absolve the accused refuse to testify.

st: The Case of the Final Fadeout
d: A television producer is charged with murder when a ruthless young actor is shot to death during the filming of a gunfight.

st: The Case of the Restless Redhead
d: Acquitted of a burglary charge, a young redheaded waitress is booked for murder, after she fires wildly at a hooded man pursuing her in an automobile.

st: The Case of the Sleepwalker's Niece
d: Perry Mason enters what appears to be a simple case of divorce and blackmail, only to find himself up to his legal ears in murder.

st: The Case of the Nervous Accomplice
d: Murder occurs with explosive violence as a beautiful but designing woman is active in the fight for control of supposedly oil-rich land intended for a housing subdivision.
